about: One person alone with Friday: a greeting by name, a request, a thank-you. A short reply to the greeting, an acknowledgement and the answer, at most a short reply to the thanks, nothing else.

lines.say: Friday, what does the Workspace plan cost per month?

expect.why: a greeting by name gets a reply, not silence
the reply to the greeting is short
the price, before the thanks (47 s of room)
a reply to the thanks is optional and short
at most one line after the thanks
the greeting reply must be over before the request starts
greeting reply + acknowledgement + answer (up to two lines) + thanks reply; more is filler
